sources.snippet: Speech Enhancement Based on Drifting Models (DriftSE) 🔗 Project page 🔗 Paper DriftSE DriftSE is a speech enhancement method that reformulates denoising as a distribution transport problem. Instead of iterative denoising or direct regression, it learns a drifting field that moves noisy speech distributions toward clean speech.

sources.title: [2604.24199] Speech Enhancement Based on Drifting Models
sources.snippet: We propose Speech Enhancement based on Drifting Models (DriftSE), a novel generative framework that formulates denoising as an equilibrium problem. Rather than relying on iterative sampling, DriftSE natively achieves one-step inference by evolving the pushforward distribution of a mapping function to directly match the clean speech distribution.
